input.claim_text: New customer onboarding follows a standard 6-week implementation process owned by the Customer Success & Delivery team.

focal_evidence.locator: heading:POL-03 — Customer Onboarding & Implementation Policy > Formal requirements#block:001
focal_evidence.text:
1. Every new-business account is assigned a named Implementation Specialist within 2 business days of contract signature.
2. Standard onboarding is completed within **6 weeks** of assignment.
3. The assigned Implementation Specialist is accountable for onboarding completion for their account, including coordinating any input required from Support or Engineering.
4. Onboarding is considered complete only when the account's onboarding checklist is marked complete in the project system.
5. Formal handover to the Support team must occur before an account is considered to be in standard support.

input.claim_text: Customer-reported issues are escalated from Support to Engineering via a ticket in the support system, following a documented severity-based escalation path.

focal_evidence.locator: heading:PROC-05 — Support Escalation Process (v1 — approved) > Steps#block:001
focal_evidence.text:
1. Support Rep classifies severity (Sev 1–3) based on customer impact.
2. Support Rep raises a ticket in the support system, tagging severity and affected system.
3. Support Lead reviews Sev 1 tickets immediately; Sev 2/3 tickets at next triage.
4. Ticket assigned to an engineer by the Head of Engineering (or delegate).
5. Engineer investigates, resolves or escalates further, and updates the ticket.
6. Support Lead confirms resolution with the customer and closes the ticket.

input.claim_text: All new hires complete a documented onboarding checklist within their first two weeks, owned by People Ops.

focal_evidence.locator: heading:POL-08 — New Hire Onboarding & Probation Policy > Formal requirements#block:001
focal_evidence.text:
1. Every new hire completes a documented onboarding checklist (systems access, policy acknowledgement, role-specific training) within their **first two weeks**.
2. The People Ops Lead is the **sole approver** of a new hire's successful completion of probation, based on input from the hire's manager.
3. Probation period is 3 months from start date.
